sources.license: Detroit Open Data Portal (Executive Order 2015-2): data may be 'downloaded, redistributed and re-used by individuals, business, researchers...'; datasets carry no explicit license (licenseInfo empty); provided AS-IS. CONFLICT: detroitmi.gov/Privacy (linked from portal footer) says 'Commercial use of the information ... is prohibited without written permission'. Nick to get written confirmation before launch.
sources.update_frequency: daily (ArcGIS dataLastEditDate 2026-10-23 08:25 UTC; max issued_date 2026-10-22, i.e. 1-2 day lag)
sources.notes: G0 2026-10-24: 47,820 permits since 2019-01-02; 570 issued last 30 days, 102 last 7 days. No contractor field. The /pages/terms-of-use URL does not exist on the Hub site (page list has no such slug); the Disclaimer page is the published terms. Fields used: record_id, address, issued_date, permit_type, construction_type, work_description, amt_estimated_contractor_cost, zip_code, neighborhood, council_district.

sources.owner: City of Detroit, BSEED via data.detroitmi.gov
sources.license: Same portal terms as detroit_permits (open data policy permits business reuse and redistribution; AS-IS; no explicit per-dataset license; written commercial confirmation pending).
sources.attribution: Data: City of Detroit Open Data Portal
sources.notes: G0 2026-10-24: 121,606 permits; 1,955 issued last 30 days (Plumbing 1,067, Mechanical 467, Electrical 349, Fire Alarm 26, Elevator 24, Boiler 13, Generator 9); 465 last 7 days; 89% have contact_business_name (contractor business of record). Many plumbing permits are DWSD lead-service-line replacements (utility work, not leads). PEOPLE-DATA RULE: never request or store owner_name or contact_name; use contact_business_name only.
